name: Ultimate Fighting Machines
caption: A tag team managed by super-promoter Richard Daly and Melanie, who challenged for and lost the ICW Tag Team Championship to Annihilation at Summer Sizzler.

name: Genocidal Dream
caption: A tag team managed by Stan the Man, who won a Barb Wire Baseball Bat/Knight Stick match on Shockfest's pre-show over "Kamikaze" Makku Torokko and Spardo.

name: The Island Rats
caption: A tag team led by manager Khan Troll, who jumped Annihilation after Summer Sizzler's tag title match and cost Lance Sweeney his own pre-show match, then won the ICW Tag Team Championship from the Bunghole Boys at Shockfest in a Dumpster Match.

name: The Bunghole Boys
caption: The ICW Tag Team Champions entering Shockfest, who lost the titles to the Island Rats in a Dumpster Match after being carried to the ring already bound and beaten.

name: The Perfectly Perfect Duo
caption: A tag team managed by Chris Wrigley, who beat the Best of the Best in a Double Dog Collar match at Shockfest, with an assist from the Island Rats, to become number-one contenders to the ICW Tag Team Championship.
